doc.brief: The QDialog class is the base class of dialog windows.
doc.index_brief: The base class of dialog windows

QSize minimumSizeHint() const override.brief: Reimplements an access function for property: [QWidget::minimumSizeHint](xref:qt:QWidget).

QSize sizeHint() const override.brief: Reimplements an access function for property: [QWidget::sizeHint](xref:qt:QWidget).

bool isSizeGripEnabled() const.brief: This property holds whether the size grip is enabled

int exec().brief: Shows the dialog as a [modal dialog](xref:qt:QDialog), blocking until the user closes it.

int result() const.brief: In general returns the modal dialog's result code, `Accepted` or `Rejected`.

void accept().brief: Hides the modal dialog and sets the result code to `Accepted`.

void accepted().brief: This signal is emitted when the dialog has been accepted either by the user or by calling [accept](xref:qt:QDialog)() or [done](xref:qt:QDialog)() with the [QDialog::Accepted](xref:qt:QDialog)...

void done(int r).brief: Closes the dialog and sets its result code to *r*.

void finished(int result).brief: This signal is emitted when the dialog's *result* code has been set, either by the user or by calling [done](xref:qt:QDialog)(), [accept](xref:qt:QDialog)(), or [reject](xref:qt:QDialog)().

void open().brief: Shows the dialog as a [window modal dialog](xref:qt:QDialog), returning immediately.

void reject().brief: Hides the modal dialog and sets the result code to `Rejected`.

void rejected().brief: This signal is emitted when the dialog has been rejected either by the user or by calling [reject](xref:qt:QDialog)() or [done](xref:qt:QDialog)() with the [QDialog::Rejected](xref:qt:QDialog)...

void setModal(bool modal).brief: This property holds whether [show](xref:qt:QWidget)() should pop up the dialog as modal or modeless

void setResult(int i).brief: Sets the modal dialog's result code to *i*.

void setSizeGripEnabled(bool).brief: This property holds whether the size grip is enabled

void setVisible(bool visible) override.brief: Reimplements an access function for property: [QWidget::visible](xref:qt:QWidget).

modal.brief: Whether show() should pop up the dialog as modal or modeless

sizeGripEnabled.brief: Whether the size grip is enabled
